name: repo-prep
description: Readies each git repository a session starts in: turns on its tracked .githooks, fast-forwards a stale local default branch, and points CHROME_PATH at Playwright's Chromium.

trustHooksFrom.title: Turn on git hooks for these owners
trustHooksFrom.description: Comma-separated GitHub owners. repo-prep turns on a repository's tracked .githooks only when its origin belongs to one of them, since a hook runs that repository's code on every commit.
